source_document: E:/git冲突问题/rehab image/动作分步骤示范图制作清单_v1.0.md
scope: 本批按制作顺序前十张中的第4–9张；动作002标准3 m TUG的六步骤
notes: 使用s01锁定场景，各阶段独立生成一张；仅s02对远侧手掌与扶手接触作一轮定点修正。原始生成图均保留。未覆写旧单图或shared清单、进度。背景灰蓝、服装白色短袖和深灰长裤、黑马尾与参考一致；补充普通白鞋。路线为生成示范图，实际三米距离仍以现场测量为准。

items.phase_zh: 背靠扶手椅坐稳，双手放扶手，双脚落地
items.prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational, photorealistic rehabilitation demonstration photo.
Make ONE standalone photograph for E-GEN-002 TUG, step 01, the initial seated ready position. NOT a collage.
INPUT IMAGES: the three provided images are strict identity, wardrobe, studio color, and photographic style references. Depict exactly the same East Asian adult woman with the same face, black low ponytail, white plain short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal-gray fitted long trousers. Add ordinary plain white low-top athletic shoes, no branding.
SCENE: maintain the references' cool gray-blue seamless studio backdrop and matching smooth gray-blue floor, soft diffuse studio light, realistic skin and cloth. A single sturdy gray upholstered armchair with backrest, TWO clearly visible side armrests and four fixed legs, no wheels, placed at LEFT of picture facing toward the RIGHT along a straight unobstructed three-metre walking route. At the chair front is a short dark-gray flat tape start line transverse to the route. At RIGHT, exactly 3 metres ahead along the same route, a parallel dark-gray flat tape turn line. No other markers, no cones, no text.
CAMERA: fixed wide landscape 3:2 composition, side-front three-quarter view, camera facing the entire route slightly from its front side. Full chair plus complete seated person and both floor lines in the same shot, all body parts and shoes unclipped, a little margin all around. Natural perspective with realistic anatomy, no fisheye, no elongated limbs.
POSE: woman sits upright and comfortably with her BACK supported against the chair backrest, BUTTOCKS firmly resting on the seat, feet BOTH flat on the floor about hip width in front of the chair, knees about right angle. She faces toward the RIGHT walking route. Each of her TWO hands rests naturally on its corresponding left/right armrest, with palms visibly touching armrests and fingers normal. Calm neutral expression; head looks along route. Hands belong to the woman.
The chair, tape lines, lighting, focus and camera composition become the invariant scene for six sequential steps. Render just this seated ready instant. No motion ghosts, no overlaid arrows, no words, numbers, labels, borders, panels, watermark, extra people, furniture or extra limbs. Keep the reference woman's identity and proportions closely.

QA.observations: 同一女性外貌、白T恤深灰长裤马尾与白鞋；灰蓝棚拍横幅；扶手椅稳固无轮；双手分别接触扶手，背靠椅，臀坐椅面、双脚平放地面；全身、椅及双标线可见。

items.phase_zh: 双手扶扶手起立，臀已离座，双足落地
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photographic rehabilitation teaching image.
Edit image 1 into E-GEN-002 TUG step 02, rising using both armrests. Generate ONE standalone photo.
IMAGE ROLES: Image 1 is the EXACT scene/composition edit target and identity/wardrobe base. Images 2–4 are the ORIGINAL strict same-woman face, hair, clothes, cool gray-blue studio and photographic-style references.
INVARIANTS: keep camera position, fixed landscape 3:2 framing, lens, field of view, size and scale, floor and seamless background color, lighting, two tape marks and their exact positions, same sturdy gray two-armrest chair on LEFT facing RIGHT, all furniture geometry and foot locations exactly as image 1. No moving furniture, no zoom/reframe. Same woman, face, black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal trousers, ordinary white shoes and normal anatomy.
CHANGE ONLY WOMAN'S POSE: she is in the middle of rising from this same chair, oriented RIGHT along the route. Her BUTTOCKS have visibly lifted 10–15 cm clear ABOVE the seat, no seat contact; knees and hips still bent, torso leaned forward naturally from hips, head looks along route. BOTH palms are visibly pressing their corresponding original left and right chair armrests, with anatomically correct fingers, both hands belong to this woman. BOTH feet remain planted flat on original floor positions in front of chair, stable hip-width spacing. This is the armrest-assisted lift phase, not standing upright and not a squat facing away. Show visible air gap between buttocks and seat. Chair remains fully visible and solid. Keep all of her head/body/limbs/shoes in-frame at the SAME human scale.
No overlaid words, numbers, labels, arrows, collage, motion ghosts, other people, extra limbs, altered armrests or invented equipment. Soft photorealistic reference quality.
items.correction_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, photographic rehabilitation demonstration.
Correct ONLY the distant/far hand-to-armrest contact in image 1. Image 2 is original scene and exact armchair reference; images 3–5 show exact woman's identity and style.
Image 1 already shows the correct rising pose: buttocks above seat, knees bent, torso forward, close hand pressing close armrest, both feet fixed on floor. Preserve this entire pose, face, hair, clothes, proportions, head position, feet position, floor and background, lighting, camera, framing, chair location and both tape marks.
The woman's FAR hand is currently visually ambiguous against her trousers. Make her far palm CLEARLY press the TOP of the FAR gray upholstered armrest, at the very same height as the near armrest. Show a short, definite visible gray upholstered horizontal support underneath the palm belonging to the chair's far armrest. Her far hand must NOT rest on thigh or knee, and not float. Correct only this contact locally, with a natural slightly bent elbow, recognizable fingers. Keep TWO hands total and TWO armrests, no extra supports or limbs.
Keep the exact same fixed landscape framing, same scene and scale. ONE standalone photorealistic photo, no text, arrows, panels, collage or watermarks.

QA.observations: 已修正远側掌压扶手位置；现双手与两扶手接触明确，臀离座有空隙、髋膝仍屈，足位固定地面。相机、椅、标线与基准一致。
QA.rejected_reason: 远侧手与扶手接触不够清楚，初版保留未删除。

items.phase_zh: 沿去程走近三米转向线，一足支撑另一足前迈，尚未转身
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photographic rehabilitation step demonstration.
Create E-GEN-002 TUG step 03 as a precise scene-preserving edit of image 1, ONE standalone landscape photo.
Image 1: exact scene edit target. Images 2–4: same woman's original face, hair, clothes, studio color and photography references.
LOCK SCENE: retain exact same landscape 3:2 framing, fixed camera position and lens, background and floor gray-blue color, studio lighting and shadows. Retain unchanged exact gray chair on LEFT, facing RIGHT, with two upholstered armrests and four fixed legs, now EMPTY. Retain both dark gray tape floor lines at their exact locations and sizes. No reframe, zoom, new chair, new marker, extra tape or people.
CHANGE ONLY PERSON'S POSE AND POSITION: the SAME woman is near the far RIGHT turn line, walking the OUTWARD direction from chair toward RIGHT. Her face, nose, chest, pelvis and feet are still pointed RIGHT; she has NOT begun turning or returning. Position her a small step BEFORE the original right tape line (about 35 cm), left behind her is the unchanged empty chair and original start tape. Natural gait: one foot planted supporting weight just short of marker, the other foot lifted a few centimetres and stepping toward the marker. Natural small opposite arm swing, neither hand touches furniture. Head looks toward RIGHT, spine upright, normal joints. Full body from head through both white shoes entirely visible, with natural adult proportions and consistent person scale; do not elongate legs, make legs huge, shrink head or crop feet. Same black ponytail, white T-shirt, charcoal long trousers, plain white shoes.
This SINGLE still instant clearly shows walking TOWARD the right turn marker before turning, no motion ghosts, no multiple poses, no text/arrows/labels/watermarks. Preserve exact photographic style and identity.

QA.observations: 人物位于右侧转向线前，脸胸髋足朝去程右侧；后足支撑前足迈向标线，未转身。空椅和双标线清楚，人物比例、手指脚和棚拍场景正常一致。

items.phase_zh: 在三米转向线处实际转身，双脚调整，躯干从去程转向回程
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photographic rehabilitation step demonstration.
Make ONE standalone photo of E-GEN-002 TUG step 04, ACTUAL TURNING at the 3-metre far line. Edit image 1 precisely. Image 1 is preceding outward walking step; image 2 is original exact scene; images 3–5 lock the original woman's identity, clothes and photographic style.
LOCK ALL SCENE: exactly same fixed camera viewpoint, 3:2 landscape crop and zoom, unchanged gray-blue studio backdrop/floor/light. EXACT same empty gray fixed-leg two-armrest chair on LEFT facing RIGHT, exact start line on left and turn line on right at their original positions. Furniture and marks do not rotate, shift or change. Keep person scale and complete head to both white shoes within frame.
CHANGE ONLY woman's placement and pose: at the far RIGHT tape turn line, she is in the middle of a controlled 180-degree TURN from rightward outward travel to leftward return toward chair. Show intermediate roughly 90-degree orientation: her torso and pelvis face mostly toward CAMERA (front view), her head has begun turning gently toward the LEFT chair, not still profile-right and not already side-profile-left walking. Feet are clearly actively repositioned for the turn: one planted foot just beside the turn line, the other makes a short turning step closer to camera/left, toes point in slightly different angles consistent with ongoing turn; both knees gently unlocked, normal anatomy, no severe twisting of knees, no crossed over legs. The visible far tape line stays beside/under the edge of turning foot and must not be hidden by the body. Hands free with small natural balance position near sides, no pointing or chair contact. She is NOT marching forward, NOT walking backward, NOT simply facing camera at the middle of the route. This is clearly the turning moment right AT the far line with empty chair across route to her LEFT.
Same woman, normal proportions, reference face/black ponytail/white T-shirt/dark gray trousers/plain white shoes. One person and two arms/legs only. No text, labels, numbers, overlays, arrows, collage, motion ghosts, added people, equipment or watermarks.

QA.observations: 在右转向线处，胸髋朝相机约转向中段，头向左椅，双脚调方向且一脚跟微提、未交叉；真实转身而非去程/回程直走。转向线、双脚、空椅清楚，场景与比例一致。

items.phase_zh: 转身已完成，面向椅子沿原路回程，双足继续迈步
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photographic rehabilitation teaching still.
E-GEN-002 TUG STEP 05: walking RETURN toward chair. ONE standalone image. Precise scene-preserving edit.
Images: 1 is exact unchanged scene/composition base seated initial photo; 2 is approved outgoing walking photo for standing person scale and outfit; 3–5 are strict reference identity/photographic style.
LOCK ALL SCENE AND CAMERA: same fixed landscape 3:2 framing, lens, camera viewpoint, gray-blue background and floor, lighting. EXACT same empty gray upholstered armchair at LEFT facing RIGHT, two armrests four fixed legs. Exact same two dark floor tape marks at original locations and geometry, no new marks. No rotate/shift furniture, no reframing, no crop or zoom. Leave entire route visible.
CHANGE WOMAN ONLY: same woman has completed the FAR-line turn and is returning LEFT toward the chair along SAME route, now in the middle-left part of route, still several normal steps short of chair; she has NOT touched chair and NOT sat down. Nose, head, torso, pelvis and shoes clearly face LEFT toward chair (opposite of outward image 2), no walking backwards. Show a natural leftward walking stride, one foot supporting and other moving forward toward LEFT/start line; small natural opposite arm swing. Feet and her full head-to-toe remain visible with the same natural standing size as image 2. Place her nearer LEFT/start than FAR line but keep a visible safe gap from chair, BOTH lines remain visible. She looks toward left chair. No leaning, kneeling, squat, turn-in-place or endpoint seated pose.
Keep identical original woman's face, black ponytail, plain white T-shirt, charcoal-gray trousers, normal limbs and body proportions, ordinary white trainers; natural hands. One woman only. No overlays, text, labels, numbers, arrows, panels, collage, ghosts, extra people/limbs or watermarks.

QA.observations: 回程左向自然迈步，脸胸髋足向左椅，前足微离地后足支持；与椅仍有间距尚未终点。双标线、椅与摄影背景保持同一设置，人体和手脚正常。

items.phase_zh: 转向后坐回原椅，双手接触扶手、臀部实坐椅面，双足落地
items.prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve, photographic rehabilitation step demonstration.
Create E-GEN-002 TUG STEP 06, the final ENDPOINT seated again after completing the return. ONE standalone scene-preserving photo.
Image 1 is exact original seated preparation scene and MUST remain unchanged except person's very slight endpoint posture; image 2 is approved armrest-assisted rising pose for the same scene; images 3–5 lock original woman identity and reference style.
STRICT INVARIANTS: identical fixed wide landscape 3:2 framing, camera viewpoint, focus, natural scale, gray-blue seamless backdrop/floor and soft studio light. EXACT same gray upholstered chair on LEFT facing RIGHT with TWO armrests, backrest and four fixed legs; both dark floor tape lines stay in exactly the same positions. No reposition/rotate/resize chair or markers. Same woman, same face, black ponytail, plain white short-sleeve T-shirt, charcoal-gray trousers and ordinary white shoes, natural anatomy.
POSE CHANGE: after returning LEFT to chair she has turned to face RIGHT along the route, and has sat back DOWN. Her BUTTOCKS are fully and visibly in contact with the seat cushion, thighs supported by chair seat, seated at original height (NOT hovering, NOT rising and NOT squatting). Keep a clear natural seated silhouette, knees bent near right angles. BOTH feet flat on floor at original stable positions, hip width, complete shoes visible. BOTH palms visibly touch and gently press their OWN corresponding TWO gray armrests as she completes controlled sitting. Each hand has real gray upholstered armrest top directly underneath it; far hand MUST NOT rest on thigh/knee. For this endpoint posture torso only slightly inclined forward by 5–10 degrees, head looking RIGHT calmly; not leaned so far buttocks lift. There is NO GAP between buttocks and seat. This is the seated finish, visually close to image 1 but with slight forward endpoint posture. Maintain full head/body/shoes and whole chair in frame, consistent proportions and background.
No words, numbers, labels, arrows, motion ghosts, panels/collage, extra people/limbs, altered furniture or watermark.

QA.observations: 臀实坐椅面无悬空、双掌分别接触扶手，双足平放地面；坐回后朝路线右方；人物全身、椅、双标线可见。保持与初始图相近且正常比例；场景、背景及外貌一致。
